turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone?
Can I ask something off the record?
There is no off the record. Owen's zero.
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned here. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear Owen first?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.

Kids who cheat. You've just called my son a cheater and me a negligent mother, Hale, and you haven't shown me a single thing. My son doesn't lie, and I'll be in the principal's office before I leave this building.
